coach-home-feed-body: A Bite is a dish worth sharing. Scroll the feed to discover what people are eating around you.
coach-bite-details-body: If the creator is public, you’ll see who shared this Bite. You’ll also see its distance from your current position and its price in your preferred currency.
coach-bite-details-share-body: Send this Bite to friends through WhatsApp or another sharing app on your device.
coach-bite-details-navigation-body: Open this Bite in your navigation app and get directions straight to the place.
coach-bite-details-bucket-list-body: Add this Bite to an existing bucket list—or create a new one—so you remember what you want to try.
coach-home-menu-body: Open the menu to find your profile, bucket lists, leaderboard, gallery, marketplace, and settings.
coach-home-feed-controls-body: Search for Users, Bites, Restaurants, or Cities; open Bitemap to explore nearby; or sort by Distance for the closest Bites and Date for the newest Bites from anywhere.
coach-create-bite-body: Tap here to add your own Bite — a photo, a place, and a few words is all it takes.
coach-map-body: See Bites around you on the map and find great food nearby.
coach-bucket-lists-body: Save Bites you want to try into lists and tick them off as you go.
coach-bucket-list-swipe-body: Swipe a Bite to the left and tap the check to mark it as tried out. Swipe again to undo it.
coach-leaderboard-body: See who shares the most Bites and climb the ranks by sharing your own.

delete-account-intro: Here is exactly what happens to your data when you delete your BiteTribe account.
delete-account-removed-profile: Your profile, display name and profile photo

delete-account-removed-bucket-lists: Your bucket lists and BiteTrail ratings
delete-account-removed-followers: Your followers and the people you follow
delete-account-kept-bites: Your Bites stay on BiteTribe without your name, so other people's bucket lists and BiteTrails keep working.
delete-account-kept-purchases: BiteTrail purchase records stay without your name, so sellers keep their sales figures.
delete-account-analytics-note: Anonymous usage and crash statistics that were already collected cannot be removed retroactively.

delete-account-public-intro: This page explains how to delete your BiteTribe account and what happens to your data.
delete-account-public-in-app-title: Delete your account in the app
delete-account-public-in-app-step-settin: Go to Settings and tap Delete Account.
delete-account-public-in-app-step-confir: Read what will be deleted and confirm.
delete-account-public-fallback-title: If you can no longer sign in
delete-account-public-fallback-intro: Request the deletion by email instead:
delete-account-public-fallback-step-subj: Use the subject line "Delete my BiteTribe account".
delete-account-public-fallback-step-acco: Include the email address you used to sign in to BiteTribe.
delete-account-public-timeframe: We will delete your account within a reasonable timeframe, unless we are required to retain certain information for legal or security reasons.
delete-account-public-scope: This deletion request applies to your BiteTribe account and data only.
profile-visibility-public-hint: Your name, photo, followers, and Bite activity can be shown in the app.
profile-visibility-private-hint: You appear as anonymous and stay off public social surfaces.
privacy-policy-language-fallback: This Privacy Policy is not yet available in your app language, so it is shown in English.
privacy-policy-intro: BiteTribe (“we”, “our”, “us”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and shared when you use the BiteTribe mobile application and related services (the “App”).
privacy-policy-account-intro: When you sign in to BiteTribe, we collect:
privacy-policy-account-email: Your email address (if you sign in with email)
privacy-policy-account-profile: Your display name and profile image (if provided by Google or Apple sign-in)
privacy-policy-account-note: Authentication is handled securely via Firebase Authentication.
privacy-policy-content-intro: When you use the App, you create and share content, including:
privacy-policy-content-location: Location data associated with a Bite
privacy-policy-content-note: This content is stored to provide the core functionality of the App.
privacy-policy-location-intro: Location data is used only when you create or view Bites to:
privacy-policy-location-attach: Attach a location to a Bite
privacy-policy-location-note: Location access is optional and controlled by your device permissions.
privacy-policy-usage-intro: We may collect basic usage data to understand how the App is used and to improve it, such as:
privacy-policy-usage-note: This data is collected using Firebase services and does not personally identify you.
privacy-policy-use-intro: We use the collected information to:
privacy-policy-use-operate: Provide and operate the BiteTribe App
privacy-policy-use-share: Allow users to create, view, and share Bites
privacy-policy-use-improve: Improve app performance, stability, and user experience
privacy-policy-use-communicate: Communicate important updates related to the App
privacy-policy-security-storage: Data is stored using Google Firebase services.
privacy-policy-security-measures: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to protect your information.
privacy-policy-security-note: No system can be guaranteed 100% secure, but we take security seriously.
privacy-policy-sharing-no-sale: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy-policy-sharing-intro: Your data may be shared only in the following cases:
privacy-policy-sharing-public: Public content you choose to share (e.g. Bites) is visible to other users
privacy-policy-sharing-providers: With service providers (such as Firebase) strictly to operate the App
privacy-policy-services-intro: BiteTribe uses the following third-party services:
privacy-policy-services-note: These services are provided by Google and are subject to Google’s privacy policies.
privacy-policy-rights-intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access your personal data, request correction or deletion of your data, and withdraw consent where applicable.
privacy-policy-rights-delete: You can delete your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy-policy-children-body: BiteTribe is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy-policy-changes-body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected on this page with an updated “Last updated” date.
privacy-policy-contact-intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, you can contact us at:
this-bite-is-no-longer-available: This Bite is no longer available. It may have been deleted.
this-bite-could-not-be-loaded-right-now: Something went wrong while loading this Bite. Check your connection and try again.
